title: Flat source opens of the finite depth-two normalization are etale
statement: Let $S$ be an integral normal Noetherian quasi-separated scheme and $c:C\to S$ a quasi-compact quasi-separated smooth morphism [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions, def-sbc-smooth-morphisms]. Let $U\subset S$ contain the generic point and let $P\to C_U$ be finite etale. Let $s\notin U$ satisfy: every point $t\notin U$ specializing to $s$ equals $s$. Suppose $\operatorname{depth}(\mathcal O_{S,s})\geq 2$ [def-weil-pbc-depth]. Set $a:\operatorname{Spec}\mathcal O_{S,s}\to S$, $L=C\times_S\operatorname{Spec}\mathcal O_{S,s}$ [def-pc-fibre-product], and let $N\to C$ be the relative normalization of $P\to C_U\to C$. Assume the pullback $n:N\times_C L\to L$ is finite. For every source open $V\subset N\times_C L$, flatness of $V\to L$ implies etaleness of $V\to L$. No section, group action, or connected-fibre assumption is made.

source.place: Tag 0EY6(2),(3), applied in Tag 0EYJ, proof of the local claim, depth-two case

proof.text: Put A=O(S,s), a=fromSpecStalk s, L=C times_S Spec A, l:L to C, q:L to Spec A, and n the finite pullback normalization. Let T=l inverse(C_U) and W=V inverse(n inverse T). Finite type over the Noetherian local base makes L locally Noetherian; finiteness of n makes its source, and hence V, locally Noetherian. The restriction of n to T is etale: normalization commutes with the smooth open immersion C_U to C, and the normalization of the finite map PA to C_U is isomorphic to that map. Pullback and restriction preserve etaleness. Thus W to L is etale. These steps are proved by two private generalized morphism-property helpers: restriction and pullback preserve any property stable under base change, and the restriction of the normalization has exactly the same isomorphism-invariant properties as the original finite map. Specialize them to Etale. No duplicate etale-only helper is declared.

Every a(t) specializes to s. Minimality and s not in U give y outside T if and only if (l composed with c)(y)=s. If x lies in V outside W, the composite r:V to L to Spec A maps x to the closed point: use the pullback equation, a(closedPoint)=s and injectivity of a. Flatness of V to L and smoothness of L to Spec A make r flat. Its stalk map is therefore flat and local. Identify the base stalk at the closed point with A via the canonical ring isomorphism. Its ring map is flat by RingHom.Flat.of_bijective and local by IsLocalHom.of_surjective. Applying the existing flat local depth formula to this map gives that the base stalk depth is at least depth A. No private depth-transport or maximal-ideal helper is needed. The flat local depth formula then gives depth O(V,x)=depth A+depth(closed fibre stalk), so depth O(V,x) is at least two. This step is fully proved in Lean.

The morphism V to L is flat by hypothesis, locally of finite type and locally quasi-finite because it is an open immersion followed by a finite map. Apply flat quasi-finite purity to its etale source open W and the depth-two boundary just proved. This proves Etale(V to L). Normality and the generic-point hypothesis are unnecessary in this route, but the original statement is unchanged.

proof_origin.place: Tag 0BJH, the purity criterion invoked in Tag 0EY6(3), with Tag 0337 for the flat source-open depth calculation
proof_origin.note: Second-reading repair: eliminate the duplicate private depth-equality lemma, using the already imported flat local depth formula across the canonical stalk ring isomorphism instead. The two generalized morphism-property helpers, target signature and decomposition remain unchanged.

theorem finiteEtale_stalk_normalization_etale_of_flat {S C : Scheme.{u}}
    [IsNoetherian S]
    [QuasiSeparatedSpace S] [IsIntegral S]
    (hS : ∀ x : S, IsIntegrallyClosed (S.presheaf.stalk x))
    (c : C ⟶ S) [QuasiCompact c] [QuasiSeparated c] [Smooth c]
    (U : S.Opens) (hηU : genericPoint S ∈ U)
    (PA : (c ⁻¹ᵁ U).toScheme.FiniteEtale)
    (s : S) (hs : s ∉ U)
    (hmin : ∀ t : S, t ⤳ s → t ∉ U → t = s)
    (hdepth : (2 : ℕ∞) ≤ IsLocalRing.depth
      (R := S.presheaf.stalk s) (S.presheaf.stalk s)) :
    letI : IsFinite PA.obj.hom := PA.property
    letI : QuasiCompact (c ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι :=
      MorphismProperty.of_isPullback (isPullback_morphismRestrict c U)
        (inferInstance : QuasiCompact U.ι)
    let a := S.fromSpecStalk s
    let n := pullback.snd (PA.obj.hom ≫ (c ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι).fromNormalization (pullback.fst c a)
    IsFinite n → ∀ V : (pullback (PA.obj.hom ≫ (c ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι).fromNormalization
      (pullback.fst c a)).Opens, Flat (V.ι ≫ n) → Etale (V.ι ≫ n)
